source.title: Quasiwypukłość i otwarte problemy analizy funkcjonalnej

accepted.question_text: Let f be a real-valued function on a space of matrices. Say that f is quasiconvex when it satisfies Morrey's Jensen-type integral inequality for every matrix A and every smooth compactly supported perturbation gradient D phi, and say that f is polyconvex when f(A) can be written as a convex function of all minors of A. Can one give a systematic theory or criterion that decides, for a given quasiconvex function on matrices, whether it is polyconvex?

evidence.quote: Do tej pory nie istnieje uporządkowana teoria pozwalająca stwierdzić, czy dana funkcja quasiwypukła jest poliwypukła.

accepted.question_text: Let f be a real-valued function on the space of m by n real matrices. Say that f is quasiconvex when, for every bounded domain Omega in R^n, every matrix A, and every smooth compactly supported vector field phi from Omega to R^m, the average of f(A + D phi(x)) over Omega is at least f(A). Say that f is rank-one convex when, for every matrix A0 and every rank-one matrix B, the one-variable function s -> f(A0 + sB) is convex. In the remaining vectorial dimensions m = 2 and n >= 2, is every rank-one convex function quasiconvex?

evidence.quote: Pytanie, czy quasiwypukłość jest równoważna wypukłości rzędu jeden w pozostałych wymiarach, czyli m = 2, n ­ 2, jest nadal otwartym problemem.

accepted.question_text: For a smooth compactly supported map f: R^n -> R^n, let Df(x) be its Jacobian matrix and let J(x,f) be det Df(x). Determine the best constant lambda_p(n) in the integral Hadamard inequality, equivalently the smallest lambda such that the integral of |Df(x)|^(p-n) J(x,f) over R^n is bounded in absolute value by lambda times the integral of |Df(x)|^p over R^n for all such f.

evidence.quote: Problem. Znaleźć najlepszą stałą λp (n) w całkowej nierówności Hadamarda (12).
Wróćmy do otwartego pytania o najlepszą stałą λp (n) w całkowej nierówności Hadamarda (12).

accepted.question_text: Let S be the Ahlfors-Beurling transform, characterized here by the property that for a smooth compactly supported complex-valued function f, S applied to the anti-holomorphic derivative of f equals the holomorphic derivative of f. What is the best constant A_p in the L^p inequality ||S omega||_p <= A_p ||omega||_p?

evidence.quote: Pytanie o najlepszą stałą w nierówności kSωkp ¬ Ap kωkp jest jednym z fundamentalnych otwartych pytań w teorii przekształceń quasikonforemnych.

accepted.question_text: Restrict Morrey's rank-one-convexity versus quasiconvexity problem to real-valued functions on 2 by 2 matrices that depend only on the Euclidean norm of the matrix and on its determinant. In this restricted class, does rank-one convexity imply quasiconvexity?

evidence.quote: Również ten wariant hipotezy Morreya jest pytaniem otwartym.

needs_review.question_text_raw: Do tej pory nie jest jasne, czy takie przedłużenie jest możliwe.

evidence.quote: Do tej pory nie jest jasne, czy takie przedłużenie jest możliwe.

trace.notes: Original zbMATH page was blocked by a browser challenge, so the zbMATH API was used only as resolver metadata. It identified Zbl 1359.49001, Agnieszka Kałamajska, Wiadomości Matematyczne 46(1), 2010, pages 1-16. The journal search page then resolved the exact article to article/view/136 and PDF download /article/download/136/133.

Mapped a 16-page PDF. Section hierarchy: 1 Wstęp; 2 Quasiwypukłość; 3 Przykłady funkcji quasiwypukłych; 4 Wypukłość rzędu jeden i hipoteza Morreya; 5 Czterdzieści lat milczenia i kontrprzykład Šveráka; 6 Dalsze własności funkcji quasiwypukłych; 7 Otwarte problemy analizy funkcjonalnej, with subsections 7.1 on integral Hadamard and Ahlfors-Beurling constants and 7.2 on K-quasiregular maps and Caccioppoli inequalities.

Section 3 states that the existence of quasiconvex non-polyconvex functions is known, but also states an unresolved lack of a systematic theory for deciding whether a quasiconvex function is polyconvex; extracted q_001.

Section 5 gives Šverák's counterexample for m >= 3 and n >= 2, then explicitly leaves the m = 2, n >= 2 case open; extracted q_002. The same section also mentions an unclear extension step in the sketch, kept as q_006 in needs_review because the source phrase depends on an antecedent.

Section 7.1 explicitly asks for the best constant in the integral Hadamard inequality, connects the two-dimensional case to the Ahlfors-Beurling transform constant, and states a restricted Morrey-variant question for functions of the norm and determinant; extracted q_003, q_004, and q_005.

Section 7.2 discusses K-quasiregular maps and Caccioppoli inequalities and ends with a broad remark that many open problems exist, but it does not state a sufficiently specific standalone problem beyond the constants already extracted from section 7.1.
